messages:
Sam: Quick sync — where are we on latency attribution for the token-cost pipeline? Need gating criteria for Stage 2 rollout and a consolidated dependency list. Can owners post a short status + blockers? @Asha @Dylan @Marie
Asha: Quick update: schema PR merged to analytics repo but the ingestion mapping is still pending. PR: https://github.com/redwood/analytics/pull/542 :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Dylan: Blocked on the router export change from eng-runtime — I pinged @Kai yesterday. Once we have header propagation we can attach request_latency_ms to token events. ETA tomorrow if no further blocks.
Kai: Noted, I'll prioritize that header patch. Small change but needs perf runs. I'll push a canary today.
deploy-bot: Canary for runtime/router v2.3.1 deployed to us-west-2 — monitoring started.
Marie: On dashboards I added latency breakdown groups (queuing, decode, kv-cache). Example SQL in the PR for weekly avg: ```SELECT bucket, avg(latency_ms) FROM token_events WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY bucket;``` Feedback welcome.
Asha: Events schema note — we added token_cost_cents (int). Sample event: ```{type: 'token', model: 'redwood-base', token_cost_cents: 3, latency_ms: 12}``` Need a quick confirm from finance that cents is the unit we want.
Sam: @Marie can you add a mapping for rollforward gating (percentile thresholds + max allowed regression) to the rollout doc? We need explicit SLOs for canary -> gradual -> full and a dependency checklist.
Marie: Will draft the checklist before EOD. Q: do we treat KV cache hit as a separate signal or combine with decode latency for gating? @Asha
Asha: Keep it separate. Cost model needs both so we can estimate token-level CPU vs GPU time.
Dylan: Also flag: storing kv-cache:true metrics will increase event volume. Suggest sampling 1/10 for kv-cache hits in the ingest pipeline to limit storage.
Kai: Perf test gist (no regressions at p95): https://gist.github.com/kai/perf-run-1995. If canary stays green I'll merge the router change.
Sam: OK — owners recap: @Asha schema + ingest, @Dylan router + sampling, @Kai runtime perf, @Marie dashboards + gating. Plan: ship schema + router change by tomorrow, canary today -> rollforward Friday if no regressions. Anyone object?
Marie: Sounds good. :thumbsup: I'll open the gating PR once the checklist is in.
Asha: Followups opened: https://github.com/redwood/analytics/pull/545
Dylan: I'll add the sampling flag to the ingest config and link the PR later today.
Sam: Thanks all — will follow up on the rollout doc after the gating PR lands.
